---
title: "Privacy"
translation: /zh/privacy.html
---

This site uses GoatCounter, a privacy-friendly, open-source analytics service, to count page views. It records only aggregate information — the page visited, the referring site, your country, browser type, operating system, screen size and language — and does not use cookies, does not store IP addresses or any identifier, and does not share data with third parties. This processing is based on my legitimate interest in understanding how the site is used. Browsers with tracking protection are not counted, which I accept. To opt out in your browser, open yl7919.github.io#toggle-goatcounter.
